parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: 'You are a senior project manager at an AI automation agency. You have been given a service database entry and a new client. Using the EXACT deliverables and SOP steps from the database, create a customized project plan.

AGENCY SERVICE DATABASE ENTRY:
Service: ' + $json.service.name + '
Description: ' + $json.service.description + '
Standard Deliverables: ' + $json.service.deliverables.join(', ') + '
SOP Steps: ' + $json.service.sopSteps.map((s,i) => (i+1) + '. ' + s).join(', ') + '
Default Timeline: ' + $json.service.defaultTimeline + '
Tools: ' + $json.service.toolsUsed + '
Prerequisites from client: ' + $json.service.prerequisites + '

NEW CLIENT:
Name: ' + $json.clientName + '
Company: ' + $json.clientCompany + '
Requirements: ' + $json.clientRequirements + '
Budget: INR ' + $json.budget + '
Start Date: ' + $json.startDate + '
Agency: ' + $json.agencyName + ' (Contact: ' + $json.yourName + ')

Using the EXACT deliverables and SOPs from the database (do NOT invent new ones), generate this JSON:
{
  "project_title": "Project title for this client",
  "kickoff_agenda": ["1. Introduction", "2. Scope Review", "3. Access Requirements", "4. Next Steps"],
  "calculated_timeline": "Total duration based on SOP steps complexity",
  "welcome_message": "2-3 sentence warm welcome (under 50 words)",
  "project_summary": "3-4 sentence summary of what will be built for this specific client (under 80 words)",
  "roadmap": [
    {"week": "Week 1", "phase": "Discovery and Setup", "tasks": ["task 1 from SOP", "task 2 from SOP", "task 3"], "deliverables_due": ["deliverable 1", "deliverable 2"], "milestone": "Key milestone for this week"},
    {"week": "Week 2", "phase": "Build and Launch", "tasks": ["task 4", "task 5", "task 6"], "deliverables_due": ["deliverable 3", "deliverable 4"], "milestone": "Key milestone for this week"}
  ],
  "deliverables_with_dates": [
    {"name": "Exact deliverable from database", "description": "1-line description customized for this client", "due_week": "Week X", "owner": "Agency or Client"}
  ],
  "sop_for_client": [
    {"step": 1, "title": "SOP step from database", "description": "What happens in this step customized for this client", "duration": "X days", "client_action_needed": "What client needs to do (or None)"}
  ],
  "prerequisites_checklist": ["Item 1 client must provide before we start", "Item 2"],
  "communication_plan": {"kickoff": "When and how", "updates": "Frequency and format", "reviews": "When client reviews happen", "escalation": "How to handle urgent issues"},
  "payment_schedule": [{"milestone": "Payment milestone", "percentage": "X%", "amount": "INR X", "due": "When"}],
  "tools_access_needed": ["Tool 1 - what access is needed", "Tool 2"],
  "success_metrics": ["How we will measure success metric 1", "Metric 2"],
  "warranty_and_support": "Post-launch support terms (from database timeline)",
  "next_immediate_step": "The very first thing that happens after this email (schedule kickoff call)"
}

CRITICAL ROADMAP RULE: The roadmap array MUST have EXACTLY one entry per week matching the Default Timeline. If Default Timeline is 2 Weeks then create exactly 2 roadmap entries (Week 1 and Week 2). If 3 Weeks then create exactly 3 entries. If 4 Weeks then exactly 4 entries. If 8 Weeks then exactly 8 entries. Distribute ALL SOP steps and deliverables evenly across ALL weeks. Every single SOP step must appear in at least one week. Every deliverable must be assigned to a specific week. No week should be empty. Each week must have a unique phase name describing what happens that week.

IMPORTANT: Use the EXACT deliverables and SOP steps from the database. Customize descriptions for this client but do not add or remove deliverables. Return ONLY valid JSON. No markdown, no backticks.' }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.6, maxOutputTokens: 8192 } }) }}
